name: STAR Assurance — Geodetic conversion accuracy audit
summary: Measures the accuracy envelope (per altitude band, 0-36,000 km) of any ECEF->geodetic library against an exact reference.
reference: exact closed-loop reference star_geodesy (forward WGS-84 transform, NIMA TR8350.2) + injected-defect self-tests
reference_observed: exact library < 1 um; injected 0.25 m height error and 1e-6 deg latitude bias measured with their injected size in the right band

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user
na.G-16: the auditor is itself the independent check; its correctness is established by injected-defect tests

review.G-06: truth points generated from the WGS-84 forward transform
review.G-08: subprocess only to run the audited library in its own venv; input via stdin JSON
review.G-13: failing library run raises; length mismatch raises
